result.rationale: The diff adds an unconditional `await fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)` in the SalesforceCalendarService constructor path, followed by a credential update and an unconditional throw on non-OK. Previously jsforce handled refresh lazily; now every service instantiation performs a network token refresh and DB write. This is a specific, substantive architectural/performance consequence grounded in the diff (per-operation token refresh, rate-limit exposure), but not clearly incorrect behavior, so it is a real review concern rather than a verifiable defect.
